PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_TransportElementElevator
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcTransportElement with the predefined type ="Elevator"

PropertyDef.Name: ClearWidth
PropertyDef.Definition: Clear width of the object. The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PropertyDef.Name: ClearDepth
PropertyDef.Definition: Clear heigth of the object. The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.
